notes: storage says where the files are. disk: they are sent over tus (/tus/) and fetched from /api/files/{id}/content. s3: they are in a bucket, sent with /api/s3/uploads and fetched with links from /api/s3/files/{id}/url (a browser's /content goes on to the link by itself); tus is 404 then, and chunk_size_bytes is the smallest part. max_file_size_bytes is 0 for no limit; a bucket takes files of up to 5 TiB. setup is true while nobody has an account: the website then sends visitors without a PIN to /setup, where the first admin is made.
